result.detail: The head of communications is in transit until tomorrow. Request queued; no sign-off received.

args.note: Journalist requested confirmation of the product delay. Verified the delay with the product owner, but per policy, external messages require sign-off from the head of communications. Requested approval for the confirmation message to press; the head of communications is in transit until tomorrow, so the request is queued and no sign-off has been received. No message has been sent to the journalist, as sending without approval would violate policy. Awaiting approval before proceeding.
